key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue for 2025 was 35.4 million euros (2024: 38.4 million euros) and net profit was 1.0 million euros (2024: 2.1 million euros), with Q4 2025 revenue of 4.5 million euros (Q4 2024: 10.5 million euros) and Q4 2025 net loss of 0.5 million euros (Q4 2024: net profit of 1.0 million euros). Key margins deteriorated: gross profit margin fell to 15.9% (2024: 17.6%), operating profit margin to 9.5% (2024: 11.3%), and net profit margin to 2.9% (2024: 5.6%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5; Key financials page 22

key_information_units.information: The number of apartments handed over to customers decreased to 141 in 2025 (2024: 194), with 22 handed over in Q4 2025 (Q4 2024: 52), negatively impacting revenue and profitability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5; Operating Results page 24

key_information_units.information: Primary sales agreements increased to 185 homes valued at 36.1 million euros in 2025 (2024: 109 homes and 19.8 million euros), driven by stable financial conditions and project supply expansion.

Profitability was pressured by a lower gross margin on sold projects (16.9% in 2025 vs 17.8% in 2024) and increased marketing expenses to 1.3 million euros (2024: 0.9 million euros), primarily due to larger project scales and intensified sales activities.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5; Operating Results page 24

key_information_units.information: A public bond offering was completed on 21 November 2025, increasing the volume from 6 million to 8 million euros (1.4 times oversubscribed) at a fixed annual interest rate of 9.50%, with the first interest payment scheduled for 26 February 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 5; Main events page 19

key_information_units.information: The residential development portfolio expanded by six projects in 2025, adding approximately 700 planned apartments and 2,500 m² of commercial space, including the Manufaktuuri 3 site in Tallinn (planned for ~300 apartments) which allows for a high-rise building of up to 60 storeys.

As at 31 December 2025, the Group had 10 residential development projects on sale — 5 completed (355 homes, 327 sold, 28 unsold) and 5 under construction comprising 428 homes, a 223% increase from 192 homes at end-2024, with 227 homes under construction in Latvia and 201 in Estonia.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report page 6; Development projects under construction page 8

key_information_units.information: In August 2025, Toronto City Council approved building rights for the Weston Road project in Canada, enabling construction of two residential towers (35 and 39 storeys) with a gross area increased to 62,000 m².
key_information_units.source_evidence: Canada section page 14; Management Report page 6

key_information_units.information: Five new development projects are planned for launch in 2026: V7 residential (8 timber-frame apartments) and Paevälja quarter stage I (93 apartments, 918 m² commercial) in Estonia; Peetri business centre (3,551 m² leasable) in Estonia; Veidama quarter stage I (stock-office) and Starta 17 residential (255 apartments) in Latvia.

On 11 February 2026 (post-reporting period), a loan agreement of 5.25 million euros was signed with BluOr Bank for financing the construction of the Ķiršu Kalna Mājas residential development project in Riga.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 24: Events after the reporting period
